package.description: Real-time synchronization, scheduled and auto backup of Windows PCs to QNAP NAS.

en-US.description: Real-time synchronization, scheduled and auto backup of Windows PCs to QNAP NAS.
en-US.longDescription: QNAP NetBak Replicator features real-time synchronization, scheduled and auto backup of the entire disk drives, documents, multimedia files and e-mails from multiple Windows PCs to QNAP NAS. It also supports backing up to a remote server via FTP and WebDAV over the Internet.
en-US.name: QNAP NetBak Replicator

zh-CN.description: 实时同步、排程及自动备份 Windows 计算机至 QNAP NAS。
zh-CN.longDescription: NetBak Replicator 协助您将 Windows 计算机上的文件、多媒体档案、电子邮件或整颗硬盘轻松备份至 QNAP NAS。简单几个点击即可快速完成实时备份、排程备份及自动备份。NetBak Replicator 亦支持 FTP 和 WebDAV 网络备份至远程服务器，即使身处异地，还是可以随时备份新增的档案。

It also supports backing up to a remote server via FTP and WebDAV over the Internet.
